name: Paul Azunre
bio: Paul Azunre is co-founder of Ghana NLP, an initiative building language technology for Ghanaian languages, and founder of Algorine, a research lab spun out of MIT. Azunre holds a computer science PhD from MIT and wrote the book Transfer Learning for Natural Language Processing. Azunre's teams built the Khaya translation app and an English-Twi parallel corpus.
known_for: Khaya translation app for African languages
Author of Transfer Learning for NLP
